invariants.summary: Routing decision path performs zero network I/O and no wall-clock sleeps.
First matching ordered rule wins; scores are explicit integer weights with no randomness.
local_with_optional_cloud pairs only with allowed or required cloud_request.
Natural policy never selects a cloud attempt (dispute forbid and natural-local gates).
Routing decides local vs cloud attempt only; it never invents Structured labels.
Missing surface/process hints degrade to speech-only without hard fail.
exact, punctuation-only, complementary, and single-provider states do not open cloud alone.
Protected-token and semantic disagreement open optional cloud before literal gates unless policy forbids.
Pause timing weights are zero toward cloud selection.
Signal collection is O(local) under remaining headroom before 1.5s Delivery.

negative_cases.summary: Do not cloud simple short everyday messages.
Do not force cloud when single provider or non-dispute agreement holds on simple speech.
Do not skip cloud eligibility on protected-token dual-STT disagreement unless policy forbids.
Natural policy never attempts cloud, including multi-section developer speech.
Pause timing alone never selects cloud.
Missing surface/process never hard-fails; speech-only path remains decisive.
